name: Grounding (Copilot)
short_description: The step in which Microsoft 365 Copilot gathers relevant work context such as files, emails and meetings via Microsoft Graph before answering, turning a generic answer into one about the user's actual work.

evidence.quote: The answer is a system called grounding
గ్రాండింగ్ లేని ఏజంట్లు నమకంగా తపులు చెబుతాయి
Grounding just means this response comes from your actual enterprise content your contracts your emails your CRM records
It's a description of Rag at Enterprise Scale. Microsoft calls it Graph Grounding.
